title: mockup_manifest
description: Contract between justthreed (Blender render producer) and justtwod (Photoshop PSD assembler). justthreed emits facts; justtwod decides how to realize them using Photoshop-native primitives (vector shapes, smart objects, real masks) so the designer's editable content stays resolution-independent.

version.description: Schema version. Breaking changes bump this integer.

product.description: Short identifier for the product (e.g. 'iphone17_pro'). Used for PSD naming and grouping.

width.description: Canvas width in pixels. Must match every pass.

height.description: Canvas height in pixels. Must match every pass.

fill.description: Base fill of the new PSD. Transparent lets the designer add their own background layer.

passes.description: Rendered raster passes. Array order is the bottom-up layer stack: index 0 sits at the bottom of the PSD.

editable_regions.description: Interactive areas where a designer's content (smart object) drops in. justtwod renders each as a vector shape + clipped smart-object placeholder, never as a rasterized mask.

scene.description: Optional scene metadata. Not required for PSD assembly; preserved for reproducibility and designer reference.

lighting_rig.description: Identifier for the lighting setup used (e.g. 'three_point_soft', 'studio_hdri').

hash.description: Opaque identifier so a rerender can be matched pixel-for-pixel.

bounds.description: Axis-aligned pixel rectangle in canvas coordinates (top-left origin).

name.description: Layer name justtwod applies when importing this pass.

file.description: Filename relative to the manifest's own folder.

role.description: Semantic role. justtwod uses this to pick default blend mode, visibility, and grouping when the optional hints below are absent.

blend.description: Blend mode hint for this pass.

visible.description: Whether the layer is visible by default in the assembled PSD. Utility passes (id_mask, depth, normal) are typically hidden.

bit_depth.description: Bit depth of the file. 16+ recommended for 'body' to avoid banding; 32 for EXR workflows.

colorspace.description: Color space the file is stored in.

premultiplied_alpha.description: True if the pass is stored with premultiplied alpha.

region.description: An editable region is realized in Photoshop as a vector shape layer (rounded rect when corner_radius is set) acting as a clipping mask for a smart-object placeholder.

name.description: Region identifier. Used for mask/group naming in the PSD.

smart_object_name.description: Name justtwod applies to the smart-object placeholder layer the designer will replace.

corner_radius.description: Pixel radius of the vector shape justtwod draws. null = sharp rectangle. Single scalar is only meaningful for face-on shots; off-axis shots should use 'perspective' (v3).

reference_resolution.description: Native resolution of the design that drops in (e.g. 1179x2556 for an iPhone 15 Pro screen). Lets a designer's Figma export at native size scale into the region 1:1 without interpolation.

perspective.description: 4-point warp for off-axis surfaces. v2 requires null; v3 will define a 4-corner projection shape.

cutouts.description: Nested regions that justtwod subtracts from this region's vector mask (e.g. Dynamic Island inside a phone screen). Recursive: a cutout is itself a region.
